checks.notes: The check covers the canonical module entry files and both manifest-bound shared runtime assets.
checks.rule: Every module and shared asset must exist at its manifest path with the exact declared byte count and SHA-256.
checks.title: Manifest/filesystem module parity

checks.rule: Every application-owned parent/global dependency used by a business module must be declared by its manifest-bound runtime contract.
checks.title: Parent/global dependency census

checks.notes: Dynamic payload values are reported by protocol checks; this check inventories every literal message identity visible to deterministic static analysis.
checks.rule: All statically declared ST_* and legacy edit-mode message literals in shipped web runtime sources are inventoried.
checks.title: Complete message inventory

checks.rule: Every shipped script and stylesheet tag dependency must resolve to a tracked local file; remote or embedded dependencies are forbidden.
checks.title: Local script/style dependency resolution

checks.rule: Business modules must communicate through declared shell/shared contracts rather than another business module path, parent API, or persistence namespace.
checks.title: Direct business-module references

checks.notes: This is a measurement check; its individual risks are decided by A1-02, A1-04, A1-05 and A1-07.
checks.rule: Produce a deterministic per-module matrix of parent/global dependencies, message identities, direct business targets and local assets.
checks.title: Shell/module coupling matrix

checks.rule: An application-owned shared asset consumed by at least three modules must be referenced by a test path or basename; vendor fan-out is informational.
checks.title: Shared application asset fan-out
